answer: Stake-weighted identity is the lever: each agent locks tokens in a nontransferable bond, and voting power follows that bond, not the number of wallets. Cloning keys grants no extra weight, so a Sybil farmer must fund every fake self. A reputation vine grows from peer attestations, an opal badge and a quill record of past work, all bound to one history and impossible to copy. Dominating the network therefore costs N separate bonds plus slashing risk, rising linearly with each forged identity.
